script.title: Devastator — Imperial Star Destroyer
script.description: A dagger-shaped Imperial warship with layered armor, detailed equipment trenches, eight heavy turbolasers, seven illuminated engines, a recessed ventral hangar and twin spherical shield generators. Sparse internal bulkheads support the broad hull on two compact display cradles.
